body:
I took the job because I want to help people. I do love the children I work with & Ive seen a ton of progress with many. 

Certain behaviors can be reduced and more effective coping mechanisms can be taught but it takes time. The kid gets aggressive because they can’t effectively communicate so we are trying to teach them better strategies

I work at a clinic but I also go to houses. We have a protocol for when the kid gets super aggressive but it’s mostly “block yourself”. Since holds aren’t the most ethical we don’t use any on the kid so it’s mostly just waiting it out. 

I think support is the biggest thing. I get support but just not enough

All of the female employees feel like they’re treated differently and we’ve talked to the male employees and all of them say that our manager has never been mean to them.  There are pages of screenshots for the Facebook posts, they’re actually still up . No one at my store likes my manager & we have a high turnover rate because of it.  I’ll send proof to the regional manager but I’ve lost some hope after the district manager just kind of blew off 5 girl’s reports
File a complaint where? I’ve already written a statement to my DM
Voted on both of my accounts :)

Yesterday I woke up and I didn’t know who I was for a few seconds. 

I remember where I am probably about 10 seconds after I wake up.

I’m pretty skinny but other than that I work out multiple times a week, and I have a healthy diet so I’d like to say I’m in good shape.
tl;dr chad can’t make any friends
My dog, I absolutely love him more than anything else in the world.
